svg.title: TCS Research & Innovation, Research Intern, AI and Robotics
svg.desc: TCS Research and Innovation, Research Intern in AI and Robotics, 12 May to 31 Aug 2025. Robotic Mobile Manipulation Platform for Retail and Warehouses: PyBullet platform with 4 warehouse scenarios and 20 object categories, RGB-D 6-DoF grasp pose prediction in clutter, PPO policy trained over a 48-hour simulation run, 15 to 30 s per-object pick cycles. Simulation only.
svg.text: Soft-gripper simulation, RGB-D 6-DoF grasping, PPO policy. Simulation only.
